thread:
olivia-cs: FYI escalation from Acme (ticket INC-3942). After v3 canary rollout they report generated infra artifacts missing run/entry steps -> CI fails. Customer says rolling back to the previous model remedies it. Attaching their repro below.

acme-dev: Quick summary from our end: we call /v1/generate with model:synthesis-v3 and a repo scaffold prompt. The generated Dockerfile and start.sh are missing the CMD and the service start lines. CI errors out with ‘no entrypoint specified’. Repro steps: 1) checkout repo, 2) run codegen endpoint with prompt, 3) commit files, 4) CI pipeline fails. Example failing artifact included.

acme-dev: ```Dockerfile
FROM node:18-alpine
WORKDIR /app
COPY . /app
RUN npm ci --production
EXPOSE 8080
# MISSING: CMD ["node", "server.js"]
```

deploy-bot: Canary rollout log: model:synthesis-v3 -> 20% at 2026-03-10T02:14:12Z, 100% at 2026-03-10T02:44:03Z. No autoscale incidents reported.

samir-eng: Thanks, digging in. Can you paste the exact prompt you used and the request/response IDs? Also send the raw model response (if possible) so we can check tokenization/stop sequences.

acme-dev: Prompt (sanitized): "Generate a Dockerfile and start script for a Node microservice that reads PORT env and starts server.js. Include run commands for Docker Compose."
Response id from header: r-20260310-9a7b3c. Sample model output (truncated):
```
FROM node:18-alpine
WORKDIR /app
COPY . /app
RUN npm ci --production
EXPOSE 8080
# start script omitted
```

janelle-se: Could be a behavior change in the stop/formatting policy or a subtle prompt-parsing regression that drops lines after comments. Two immediate asks: 1) Olivia, can you escalate ticket with the response payload and request header (we need model name and generation params)? 2) Samir, can you try reproducing against the canary rollout snapshot (model:synthesis-v3@20260310-0214) in a staging org?

olivia-cs: Escalation updated with payload and response headers (INC-3942). Attached request id and model snapshot. Customer says they tried adds like "Ensure CMD present" and still saw omission.

samir-eng: Reproduced locally against the snapshot using the same prompt + params. I can reproduce missing CMD in ~60% of attempts when using max_tokens small and when stop sequences include a trailing comment token. Suspect a tokenization/stop-seq interaction.

qa-bot: Adding automated regression test case to CI: codegen -> generated Dockerfile must contain CMD or ENTRYPOINT. Will run against current model and previous stable to measure delta.

olivia-cs: Customer wants ETA for a fix or a recommended mitigation. They are blocked in multiple pipelines.

janelle-se: Short-term mitigation: add a post-processing rule in the SDK/Console that enforces/patches missing run steps for Dockerfile artifacts (detect missing CMD and append a safe default). Long-term: roll a canary patch to synthesis-v3 with adjusted stop-seq handling and re-run regression tests.

acme-dev: Thanks — a patch in the SDK that appends CMD would help us for now. Please keep us posted (we can schedule a rolling deploy after patch).

samir-eng: I'll open an internal PR for the stop-seq fix and a validator rule. Linking PR when ready.

olivia-cs: Noted. I'll update INC-3942 with the workaround and the internal PR link once available. :thumbsup:
